{
  "root_cause": "The Escape key handler in src/controllers/listController.js clears the input value (ctx.input.value = \"\") before closing the suggestion list, causing the user's typed city to be lost when dismissing suggestions.",
  "repair_strategy": "Modify the navigate function in src/controllers/listController.js to retain the input value when Escape is pressed, only closing the suggestion list and emitting the clear event.",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "src/controllers/listController.js",
      "sha256": "913fcec2ffc448fd458cae19dd873623256f7e1c1ba3eab15225d68f74351f8f",
      "before": "    // Esc\n    case 27:\n      // Clear \"input\" value\n      ctx.input.value = \"\";\n\n      /**\n       * @emit {clear} event on input clear\n       **/\n      eventEmitter('clear', ctx);\n\n      close(ctx);\n      break;",
      "after": "    // Esc\n    case 27:\n      /**\n       * @emit {clear} event on input clear\n       **/\n      eventEmitter('clear', ctx);\n\n      close(ctx);\n      break;"
    }
  ],
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Escape will close the suggestion listbox (setting aria-expanded to false and hiding the list), return focus to the combobox input, and leave the input value unchanged, preserving the user's typed city while maintaining correct combobox state.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "Consumers that rely on the 'clear' event being accompanied by an actual value reset may observe a mismatch, though the event is still emitted.",
    "If the intent of Escape was to cancel the current input, the value will persist; however the requirement specifies Escape should retain the typed value."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "After typing text and pressing Escape, the suggestion list must be hidden (no visible #city-list).",
    "Focus must return to the #city input.",
    "The input's value must remain exactly what the user typed.",
    "ArrowDown and Enter selection of a suggestion must continue to work.",
    "Tab key behavior (with tabSelect) must remain unchanged."
  ]
}
